name: Pallof press
summary: Band anchored to one side, held at the chest; press it straight out and resist the twist.
setup: Anchor a band at chest height to one side. Stand side-on to the anchor, holding the band at the chest with both hands, feet hip-width. Press the hands straight out in front, hold two seconds, bring them back. Do not let the band turn you.
why: The press moves toward the phone and the twist it resists is invisible. Logged by hand.
tempo: Press 1 s, hold 2 s, return 1 s.
progression: Heavier band; half-kneeling; hold the press longer.
regression: Lighter band; stand closer to the anchor.

faults.label: Turning toward the anchor
faults.tip: Brace before the press; the point is to not move.

faults.label: Leaning away
faults.tip: Leaning away uses body weight instead of the core. Stand tall and let the abs do it.

faults.label: Rushing the press
faults.tip: The hold with the arms out is where the anti-twist work happens.

faults.label: Feet shifting
faults.tip: Shuffling the feet lets the body turn instead of resisting the turn.

guide.cannotSee: The press and the twist it resists.

points.t: Square to the front; no twist, no lean.
